title: A second site is added without deploying new code
description:
A site should be data, not a repository or a deploy.

```gherkin
Feature: Add a site as data

  Scenario: The second site appears
    Given a running deployment with one site
    When an administrator adds a second site with a name, a domain and a theme
    Then the second site is built and served
    And no backend was deployed and no engine code changed
```
